reviewedRevision: 6dd0f66 plus the rework in this commit
independentProbes: Fuzz of 96 runs (337k frames, solo at five unlock levels and two-player, hostile dt and pointer values) broke no invariant; passive contact dealt no damage; play was identical at 30, 60 and 120 Hz. The reviewer's own lesson-following bot cleared every stage at 0.25 s and 0.35 s reaction and won 18 full 20-champion campaigns in EN and ZH at all three rates; at 0.45 s it clears stages 1-4. Holding Quick and advancing wins 2.3% overall.

findings.observation: Holding Quick and walking forward beat all six champions in 40 of 40 seeds, because the AI never reacted to the player's wind-up. Champions now see the player through a per-champion reaction delay and guard, parry, retreat or counter; chained swings cost stamina, tired swings hit softer, later champions have poise, and blocks and parries punish.

Only 6 stages and no level select. There are now 20 stages (teaching 1-6, combination 7-14, mastery 15-20) with bilingual lessons, a stage select and env.progress continue; broken stores fall back to stage 1.
The 1,325-line file was split into eight modules, the largest 669 lines.
Two-player matches no longer write the shared best score or progress.
Quick, Heavy and Guard taps shorter than a frame are latched.

Stages 1-4 give at least 0.5 s of champion wind-up so slower players can learn; tired swings are explained and flagged on screen; draw messages follow how the duel ended; stage tags show only real differences; stage 20 reads FINAL.

openNotes: Mashing Heavy wins 73% and 60% of the tutorial stages 1 and 2 (Heavy starts faster than their 0.5 s champion wind-up); from stage 3 no blind policy exceeds 17%.
A player who reacts in 0.55 s or slower still struggles from stage 2.
A poke-then-kite strategy wins 5 of 12 on stage 15 only.
The mutual-KO message was exercised only at message level.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened stage 1 of 20 (Gate Recruit); walking, Quick and Guard keys moved and swung the knight, stamina and health bars reacted, and the lesson line was shown.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (371 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the six touch buttons (左 右 跳跃 举盾 轻击 重击) moved the knight and swung.
The console showed no errors or warnings.
